response.justification: Bogdan is a strong senior engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and broad full-stack expertise, but he falls short on two hard requirements: the role demands German at C1 level while his resume lists German as basic, and it requires proven leadership of teams and client-facing consulting at an executive level, which his career as an individual contributor (aside from a solo open-source founder project) does not demonstrate.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience across web, backend, embedded, and high-scale distributed systems
Genuine open-source commitment (GISCollective founder, D language libraries, FOSS4G speaker) aligned with digital sovereignty focus
Strong mentoring/knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: German listed as basic, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal experience leading or managing development teams or overseeing multiple client projects
Limited evidence of IT architecture governance, UML modeling, requirements management, or security/compliance advisory work

key_factors.factor: Strong open-source and Linux technical background
